verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a Registrar API for 'searching, checking, registering, and managing domains' (docs-10), which covers the core purchase/lookup flow needed for a deploy script, and WHOIS/contact data can be edited (docs-17). However, nameservers are not a scriptable choice — all domains automatically use Cloudflare's own nameservers with no way to set custom ones (docs-24, comm-2, comm-9, comm-10, comm-14), and there's no evidence pack detail of a discrete contacts-management API endpoint or a documented end-to-end purchase call sequence. Missing for 10: explicit API endpoint docs/examples for contact submission, evidence of a full scripted purchase call, and confirmation that nameserver configuration is exposed via API (it isn't, since it's fixed).
